explanation: His wax sculpture Little Dancer Aged Fourteen wore a real fabric tutu and hair ribbon, which startled critics when it was shown in Paris in 1881.

claims.text: Edgar Degas is best known for paintings and pastels of ballet dancers.
Claude Monet, Camille Pissarro and Paul Cézanne are not known for pictures of ballet dancers.
Degas's wax sculpture Little Dancer Aged Fourteen was dressed in a real fabric tutu and bodice with a satin hair ribbon.
Little Dancer Aged Fourteen was first shown in Paris in 1881, at the sixth Impressionist exhibition, and startled critics.
